turns.question: What was the total ad spend on days when the email campaign had no booked lead, from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that totals ad spend over only the days on which a channel had no bookings, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR) and Bookings, each of which can be filtered to the email channel and grouped by day, but combining them across days is not something the layer computes.
